caption: No point spending minutes building an image for code that was always going to fail.

code:
FROM python:3.12 AS builder
RUN pip install --target=/deps -r requirements.txt

FROM python:3.12-slim
COPY --from=builder /deps ...
COPY src/ ./src/
CMD ["python", "src/main.py"]
caption: Compilers and build tools stay in stage one — only the slim runtime stage ships.
The tag IS the commit — never a question of which source produced this image.
The pushed image shows up in the repository's own Packages sidebar.
